symptom: `create nanoflow … export level api` passed check and exec reported 'Created nanoflow', but bson dump showed ExportLevel "Hidden" and describe printed no clause; the same clause on a microflow was stored as API
cause: Nanoflows share the microflowOptions grammar rule, so the clause parsed — but ExitCreateNanoflowStatement read only FOLDER and EXPOSED AS from it, and CreateNanoflowStmt / sdk Nanoflow had no field to carry it
insight: A grammar rule shared between two statements gives both the syntax, not both the semantics: every option a shared rule accepts must be read, or refused, by EACH visitor that uses it — URL and concurrency clauses on a nanoflow still parse and drop the same way (Nanoflows$Nanoflow has no such properties, so those want a refusal, not a write). describe nanoflow has two renderers (describeNanoflow for the command, renderMicroflowMDL via nanoflowAsMicroflow for create-or-modify's comparison); fixing one made the re-run report 'Unchanged' while the describe command still omitted the clause — test both. Version safety came from genMf.VersionInfos: MicroflowBase.exportLevel has no Introduced entry (returnVariableName has 10.12.0), so the key is declared at every supported version; the Model SDK npm package (4.116) has no exportLevel at all and cannot arbitrate this one.
